name: publishjgivenreport
description: Extension that publishes JGiven test reports in Azure DevOps console

scripts.build: tsc -p . && esbuild dist/enhancer/tab.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=jgivenTab --outfile=dist/tab.js --external:VSS/* --external:TFS/* --external:jquery && node scripts/wrap-amd.js && tsc -p publishjgivenreport/
